title: A machine-learning algorithm for neonatal seizure recognition: a multicentre, randomised, controlled trial
summary: In a multicentre randomized trial, ANSeR-assisted review improved recognition of seizure hours (66.0% vs 45.3%) but not patient-level seizure identification; the result is limited to detection performance.

evidence.tested: In a multicentre randomized trial, ANSeR-assisted review improved recognition of seizure hours (66.0% vs 45.3%) but not patient-level seizure identification; the result is limited to detection performance.
evidence.unknown: Affiliation was not available in the reviewed primary bibliographic metadata.
evidence.ai_role: ANSeR machine-learning seizure-detection output was displayed in real time to clinicians during continuous EEG monitoring.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
